nodes.name: batches.json
nodes.summary: Records the semantic analysis plan for 521 project files across 28 batches, including per-file metadata, resolved internal imports, exported symbols, and cross-batch neighbors.
nodes.languageNotes: The generated JSON preserves deterministic batch membership and dependency context for parallel graph analysis.

nodes.name: frontend-structure.json
nodes.summary: Stores deterministic structural extraction results for 148 frontend files, including functions, classes, exports, call graphs, metrics, and non-code structures.
nodes.languageNotes: The generated JSON is the machine-readable result of the bundled tree-sitter and non-code extraction pipeline.

nodes.name: scan-result.json
nodes.summary: Captures the authoritative project scan for 521 files, with language, framework, category, size, complexity, and resolved import metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: This generated inventory is retained as the deterministic baseline for batching and future incremental graph updates.
